text:
Alex (oncall): Quick handoff — I just wrapped the immediate mitigation for the ML inference timeout spike that started at ~03:10 UTC. Root cause still unknown but we mitigated customer impact by routing traffic to the fallback model pool and temporarily increasing the KV cache TTL.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-412 created and pages sent to #eng-oncall, #support. Priority: P2.

Maria (platform): Thanks Alex. Can you summarize what you changed and any config snippets? I want to capture in the runbook.

Alex (oncall): Sure — changes below.

```
# temporary routing override
route_policy: {
  primary_pool: model-a-v2
  fallback_pool: model-a-v1
  override_until: 2026-06-10T04:30:00Z
}
# KV cache tweak
kv_cache_ttl_seconds: 1200  # bumped from 300
```

Alex (oncall): Customer impact: ~3% of requests hit 500/timeout over a 12-min window before mitigation. No data exfiltration. Affected customers were on dedicated pool eu-west-1b using model-a-v2. Support ticket opened for each customer.

Priya (support): Filing customer tickets now: SUP-7821, SUP-7822, SUP-7823 — linked to INC-2026-412. I'll send an outbound message template in a sec.

Jordan (sre): Noted. Any evidence of infra degradation vs model runtime? I saw GPU mem pressure in the metrics but need logs.

Alex (oncall): Stack traces show a surge of KV cache misses which correlated with longer decode loops. GPU mem looked normal, CPU for the runtime host spiked. I pulled a flamegraph and attached to the incident.

Maria (platform): Runbook pointer: "Model pool degrade -> fallback routing" section. Steps taken look correct. We should add a new step: verify kv cache eviction thresholds are healthy after restarts.

Alex (oncall): Agreed. Action item: add eviction threshold check to runbook. Assigning to Maria.

Maria (platform): I'll update the runbook and push a docs PR — ETA EOD my timezone (Europe).

Jordan (sre): For next shift: I'll take primary until 07:00 UTC to keep an eye on replay traffic and the new routing fallback. Alex, you good to be secondary?

Alex (oncall): Yep, I'll be secondary and reachable on pager. Jordan — I left the temporary override in place until we confirm stability.

Priya (support): I'll follow up with the three affected customers and add a note to their support cases about the temporary fallback and ETA for permanent fix.

IncidentBot: Postmortem checklist created: PM-INC-2026-412. Retro meeting scheduled for 2026-06-12 15:00 UTC. Organizer: ops-eng@redwood.ai.

Alex (oncall): Coverage gap note: overlap between shifts is 10 minutes instead of our standard 20 starting tonight due to timezone scheduling. That leaves a small window where both primary and secondary might be out of immediate sync. Action: ops to adjust rotation to ensure 30-minute overlap for cross-region incidents. Assigning to Jordan to raise a scheduling ticket.

Jordan (sre): Will file rotation-adjust ticket (OPS-4110) and propose new rota with +20m overlap for eu->na handoffs.

Maria (platform): Tickets and action items summary to copy into the incident:
- Runbook update: eviction threshold check (owner: Maria)
- Ops rotation ticket: ensure 30m overlap (owner: Jordan)
- Engineering follow-up: root-cause deeper analysis of KV eviction pattern + model runtime perf (owner: Alex)
- Support: customer comms and case updates (owner: Priya)
- Postmortem and retro (owner: IncidentBot/ops-eng)

Alex (oncall): Added timeline notes to INC-2026-412. Next steps for me: attach logs, schedule deep-dive with model infra team tomorrow 10:00 UTC.

Priya (support): Sent outbound to customers, they acknowledged. Marking SUP tickets as awaiting engineering follow-up.

Jordan (sre): I'll monitor for 2 hours and escalate immediately if errors > 1% for 5 consecutive minutes. My contact: pager + Slack.

Alex (oncall): Thanks team. Handoff complete. If anyone picks this up before the retro, add notes to INC-2026-412. :rocket: 

Priya (support): Thanks Alex. And thanks Jordan for taking prim.

Jordan (sre): Got it — taking primary.

IncidentBot: Thread closed by Alex (oncall) — status: monitoring."
